description:
The owner's direction (2026-08-30), BEAM-inspired: analysis identity should
coalesce at name/arity (per root) -- specializations ROOTED there as content,
with value-keyed identities minted only AT SETTLEMENT where the backend needs
them (quicksort(int) != quicksort(float) as executables, not as free-floating
demanded analysis identities). BEAM's M:F/A is the only identity; clause
selection is behavior, not naming.

## The measured case
- ~20% of AnalyzeActivation evaluations land on identities that never reach
  the artifact (231/1081, 60/306, 120/886 across the three target fixtures;
  67/14/32 abandoned intermediate keys) -- warm-up work on names that stop
  existing, plus the indirect cost of their ReturnType bumps waking callers.
- 98% of preservation traffic is key migration (fz-kdt.69's measurement):
  value-named identities churn by construction under a monotone ascent.
- The widening budget, convergence_class, fz-y6w's collapse, fz-kdt.65's
  ladder are all compensation for minting identities from ascending values.

## The shape
- Stable analysis cell per (root, function) -- or per (root, function,
  dispatch-class): the body determines a FINITE set of clause-dispatch
  outcomes and DispatchMask already projects to dispatch-relevant positions.
  Evidence ascends WITHIN a class as cell content; classes don't churn.
- Identity at settlement: settled evidence crystallizes into value-keyed
  ExecutableKeys (the backend already derives these from settled activations).
- Prior art in-tree: the SpecKey/BodyKey split (fz-xqw) already separates
  demanded-identity from body-identity.

## THE central design question (decides feasibility)
Within-class evidence joins during the ascent. Today's per-arrow keys give
per-type return evidence; a class-rooted cell could widen conclusions
(int|float joining where they ascend separately today). Either per-evidence
rows live as the cell's settled CONTENT without being demanded identities, or
the artifact loses precision. The inventory-width pins (59/221/214) and the
canonical backend form are the instruments: any artifact movement is the
answer.

## Process
Full treatment: investigate (measure per-function arrow-family sizes and
within-class join effects), propose to a cold agent, integrate, decompose.
Sequenced AFTER fz-kdt.69 (whose edge/index groundwork any model needs, and
whose Story 1 producer-map fix is required under every model).
title: Coalesce analysis identity at name/arity: dispatch-class roots, value identity at settlement
